arguments.note: Describe the caller selection of the exact imported layers and layout.

notes: Review the plan blockers and origin. Only standard RGB 8-bit PSD saved raster layers are supported; flatten unsupported styles/masks in the drawing tool first.
Supported common tags: [bone:name], [slot:name], [skin:name], [folder:name], [path:name], [origin], [ignore], [pad:N], [trim:true/false], group [bones]/[slots]. Unsupported tags block.
New PNG/JSON files and native project are created. Source PSD and current editor project are preserved. unitsPerPixel changes attachment world units; it does not resample PNG pixels.

Use get_job/cancel_job/recover_job for detached imports. Stable import requestId resumes matching partial PNGs and rejects altered bytes. Logical PSD paths remain in the manifest; actual PNG paths are generated safely.
